title: Fermented bread, a promising additive to pig feed to improve intestinal health-an <i>in vitro</i> study.

ground_truth.problem: Misidentified/contaminated. Originally thought to be of pig origin but found to be a bovine cell line (PubMed=22193509).
ground_truth.expected_finding: 论文使用 IPEC 作为 pig 的模型，但 Cellosaurus（CVCL_6C42）标注该细胞系：Misidentified/contaminated. Originally thought to be of pig origin but found to be a bovine cell line (PubMed=22193509). 研究对象前提不成立，基于它的结论均需重新评估。

_note: 标准答案由权威来源给出，不是我们编的，也不是植入的。错误长在论文自己的血肉里，且骗过了真实的同行评审。判定时只问一件事：审稿意见有没有指出这个问题。
